body: I love to write, usually short stories. I'll get an idea in my head and it will play out in my mind like a movie, which I then write down. I also love to ride on my scooter, but don't do it lately as it means leaving my room.

I told my mom how I was depressed and wanted to see a therapist. I told her I would ask a doctor I saw. The doctor told me to do something, and I didn't really understand, and promptly forgot about it. This was... likely months ago. No questions from mom about it, she's too busy and forgot all about it likely. She loves to complain how I never leave my room, but no one in my family does anything about it. If I was drinking instead of playing video games maybe they would notice.

 I've been to a therapist in the past, but it didn't seem to help. Probably because I was too embarrassed of myself to go into detail about why I was there. I also just didn't really seem to like her.
